Distributed reasoning systems increasingly require provenance-aware interpretive behavior.
interpretation: Interpretive honesty may itself function as a continuity-preserving primitive under semantic acceleration.

statement: Language models interacting with continuity-preserving semantic substrate may significantly improve interpretive stability, trust, and reconstructability when explicitly guided toward semantic fidelity, epistemic transparency, and lineage preservation.
